messages:
maria: Quick follow-up to the quant RFC — we need to decide telemetry and fallback signals for INT8 / 4-bit paths. The RFC had 'basic counters' but SRE worried about silent quality regressions.

ashwin: Agreed. Propose three signals: 1) per-model eval-quality delta on a pinned prompt set, 2) rollout-level degraded-cohort rate, 3) per-request variant/kernel tag. Token-level perplexity in prod is noisy and expensive.

oliver: Ops/SRE here: we also need sampled raw outputs for offline scoring (no client-visible). Sampling ~0.1% salted by user id is fine. High-cardinality tags: quant_profile, kernel_version, runtime_build.

zoe: Research: 0.1% sampling + salted hashing works. Important: store prompt hash + model+quant_profile only after PII redaction. We'll compute quality_score offline and join back to events by sampled_output_hash.

deploy-bot: RFC PR updated: https://repo/redwood/rfcs/quant-telemetry PR#87

maria: Implementation contract: runtime emits a minimal structured event per request: variant, kernel, seq_len, latency_ms, fallback_reason. We'll version it as schema v0 and publish in the RFC.

ashwin: Implementation notes: prefer events to kafka topic `quant-telemetry-v0` and expose aggregated metrics (histograms for latency, counters for fallback). Add a small consumer job that computes sampled_quality per model daily.

oliver: Alerting ask: if cohort_degraded_rate > 2% over 10m OR sampled_quality_drop > 0.5 on eval set, fire P1 to oncall and trigger automated canary pause. Also need retention policy for sampled outputs.

zoe: For automated rollback: gate canary percent on sampled eval score delta. We need an API in rollout service to accept quality signals (float) and adjust canary. I'll spec that.

maria: Action items (EOW): (1) ashwin add event schema + kafka producer, (2) zoe define eval prompt set & scoring job, (3) oliver add alerts and retention, (4) maria update RFC with schema link.

ashwin: I'll drop a draft schema in this thread later today.

zoe: Note on storage TTLs: suggest prod sampled outputs TTL=30d, internal-flagged exports 90d. Research may need longer but we can expose exports.

maria: Sounds reasonable :thumbsup:

ashwin: Draft schema below: ```
{
  "ts": "int", 
  "model": "string", 
  "model_version": "string", 
  "quant_profile": "string", 
  "kernel": "string", 
  "variant": "string", 
  "seq_len": "int", 
  "latency_ms": "float", 
  "fallback_reason": "string|null", 
  "sampled_output_hash": "string", 
  "quality_score": "float|null", 
  "env": "string", 
  "region": "string"
}
```

oliver: LGTM. Make sure to include runtime_build and consumer_schema_version.

maria: Added schema link to RFC: https://repo/redwood/rfcs/quant-telemetry#schema

ashwin: I'll open the runtime PR on monday and wire the kafka producer. Will post metrics names here once done.

zoe: I'll run a small INT8 vs FP baseline on our eval set tomorrow and post preliminary deltas.

maria: Thanks all — we'll reconvene after the first rollout snapshot. Closing loop for now.
